expression: oi = ts_backfill(operating_income, 60); fund = rank(ts_rank(oi / cap, 252)); revert = rank(-ts_delta(close, 5)); 0.7 * fund + 0.3 * revert
hypothesis: operating income high vs its own 1y history (scaled by cap) predicts returns; blended with 5d reversal

expression: oi = ts_backfill(operating_income, 63); group_zscore(winsorize(ts_zscore(oi / enterprise_value, 252), std=3), industry)
hypothesis: operating income yield on enterprise value unusually high vs its own year, compared within industry

expression: oi = ts_backfill(operating_income, 63); fund = group_rank(ts_delta(oi, 252) / cap, industry); intraday = group_rank(-ts_zscore(close / vwap, 5), subindustry); 0.7 * fund + 0.3 * intraday
